references.label: Numbered rack features
references.description: Targets and lanes that add a pool ball when its number flashes.

references.label: Selection and value spinner
references.description: Spinner that can move the flashing number selection after play begins.

references.label: Top-left corner pocket
references.description: Hidden top-left area that moves the flashing selection and returns the ball up top.

references.label: Upper-left and lower-right drop banks
references.description: Banks that advance Bonus X through 3x, 5x, and 10x.

references.label: Lower-right award target
references.description: Target that rotates among Spinner, Spot Number, and Extra Ball.

references.label: Lower-left Special outlane
references.description: Outlane that collects Special after the rack is complete.
